_comment: CPU-budget calibration workload on the reference machine (Apple M2 Max, Release, 2026-11-03): mm_render --bench module:oversampled_tanh --instances 100 --seconds 5 --set factor=4 --set drive_db=6. CI runners measure the same and scale the budget limits by max(1, measured / reference).
